news.title_en: Bristol Bay Regional Seafood Development Association Receives NOAA Saltonstall-Kennedy Grant to Expand Food Service Market for Wild Alaska Sockeye Salmon

news.summary_en: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:  The Bristol Bay Regional Seafood Development Association (BBRSDA) has been awarded $499,400 from NOAA Fisheries’ Saltonstall-Kennedy (S-K) grant program to fund a new project called “Wild Alaska Sockeye Salmon in Food Service.”
